named_hit.identity: Caster plus effect name; thresholds and reductions reuse existing descriptor counters.
named_hit.order: Freeze parent coefficient, damage, reach and critical chance; append one parent hit, finish all nested hit listeners, resume the next frozen parent hit.
named_hit.critical_context: Per-caster/per-name expected critical fractions; normal-only critical bonuses do not apply to skill damage. Named notifications pass their hit-critical context and restore their parent frame on return.
named_hit.lifetime: Personal event counters reset on down through the existing down path. The named critical fraction retains the pinned reference RNG-accumulator lifetime.
named_hit.interest: Build per-name owner masks from compiled subscribers before battle. Unobserved names use the existing fast path. No CPU-generated event schedule is uploaded.

forced_slot.selection: Compiled ordered definition mask from the active favorite version and source slot, owned by the caster; exclude the forcing definition itself.
forced_slot.order: Reuse direct activation and existing lifecycle hooks. Evaluate source conditions with inherited critical/core context. Do not generate synthetic timing notifications or reset periodic grids.
forced_slot.validation: Require target_skill in skill slots 1..3. Reject cross-owner, self, auxiliary and out-of-range definition references. Private continuation events cannot be authored.

common_executor: Existing bounded DFS and direct-activation frame. Private continuations 55 and 56 implement hit-loop resumption and source-slot traversal; they do not introduce character-name execution branches.
independent_witnesses: Nested frozen parent: 3600 then 10200 total, parent counter 3 then 6, same-name other-owner hit does not advance it.
Separate critical fractions by name: 3375, 6750, 11025, 15300 cumulative; normal-only critical bonus excluded.
Forced slot: marker 1 at startup, expired ATK 0, marker 2 after extra use, marker 3 on the original periodic grid.
interaction_witnesses: Critical hit forces another skill slot with inherited condition context
Down/revive retains fraction but resets personal event counts
Complete raw Eve in the enemy-code condition, reordered Eve, Julia favorite stages 1 and 2
positive_controls: Derive parent notices and buff/damage follow-ups from the compiled listener graph; inspect CPU outputs without adding buff queries or uploading CPU traces to GPU.
regression_scope: Unchanged old compiled programs, existing magnitude witnesses and squads, long normal squads, equipment/growth/worker fallbacks, existing three-route API and new live preview fixtures. Full normal suite not repeated this phase.
model_limits: No blanket in-game verification. CPU reference behavior remains an explicit model.
The legacy deferred-B3 bonus handler retains its existing callback semantics; this phase does not establish new game rules there.
Named skill-hit thresholds require literal integers and unambiguous nonnumeric names. Unknown forms remain rejected.
Julia favorite stage 3 and Sakura summer still have other unsupported mechanics.
